evaluation_protocol: not applicable (review)
claimed_novelty: Trends and gaps; recommends transfer learning and semi-supervised learning
what_they_dont_do: No evaluation protocol proposed
how_ours_differs: We address deployment evaluation rather than new learning methods

paper: Change-point detection in wind turbine SCADA data for robust condition monitoring with normal behaviour models
problem: Change points break normal-behaviour models in WT SCADA
method: Kernel change-point detection with new bandwidth/penalty heuristic
data: 600 signals, 33 turbines, >2 years
evaluation_protocol: signal-level F1 for change-point presence
claimed_novelty: First systematic evaluation of change points for NBM training data
what_they_dont_do: Wind; cleans training data rather than measuring alarm burden
how_ours_differs: We show regime changes (seasonal) drive AE false alarms in DH and avoid them by setpoint-relative representation

paper: Increasing transferability for automated fault detection and diagnosis in HVAC systems through a hybrid AI methodology
problem: Transferable residual-based FDD for HVAC AHUs
method: Rule-based filtering of training data + bank of MLP residual models with tolerance band
data: Nine AHUs in three buildings
evaluation_protocol: detection rate and false alarm rate
claimed_novelty: Hybrid rules+ML improves FD rates; residual models prone to false alarms when nominal behaviour is under-learned
what_they_dont_do: HVAC not DH; residuals vs model prediction, not vs controller setpoint
how_ours_differs: Our residual is relative to the controller's own setpoint and is scoped to comfort loops

paper: Whole building HVAC diagnostic Bayesian networks for comfort-related fault detection and diagnosis: Application, evaluation and operational testing
problem: Whole-building comfort-related HVAC FDD
method: Diagnostic Bayesian network with knowledge and data-driven parameters
data: Office building in the Netherlands; historical data + AHU fault injection
evaluation_protocol: classification rate 87.8%, false alarm 3.8%, miss rate >25%
claimed_novelty: System-level DBN for comfort-related faults with operational testing
what_they_dont_do: Not DH; no false alarms per asset-year; not setpoint-relative scoping comparison
how_ours_differs: We isolate comfort scope as a factor and measure its effect on alarm burden

paper: Comparison of Single Control Loop Performance Monitoring Methods
problem: Single control loop performance monitoring
method: Comparison of nine model-free CPM methods (KL divergence, ISE, ITAE, etc.)
data: Simulated supercritical CO2 extraction process
evaluation_protocol: simulation fault scenarios at varying intensities
claimed_novelty: Ranks robust model-free CPM indices
what_they_dont_do: Industrial simulation; no alarm burden; not DH
how_ours_differs: We apply setpoint-relative loop monitoring to DH comfort loops and compare to AE fault detection

paper: Building fault detection data to aid diagnostic algorithm creation and performance testing
problem: Lack of common building FDD benchmark data
method: Public dataset from simulation and experimental facilities with fault ground truth
data: Multiple building system types, seasons, fault severities
evaluation_protocol: not applicable (dataset)
claimed_novelty: First public building FDD dataset with presence/absence ground truth
what_they_dont_do: No evaluation protocol for alarm burden
how_ours_differs: We contribute a deployment protocol on a public DH dataset

paper: Privacy-Preserving Fleet-Wide Learning of Wind Turbine Conditions with Federated Learning
problem: Fleet-wide normal behaviour models with private data
method: Federated learning of NBMs; personalised global model
data: Wind turbine fleet bearing temperatures
evaluation_protocol: NBM accuracy and fault detection accuracy (case studies)
claimed_novelty: Turbines with little data benefit from fleet learning
what_they_dont_do: Wind; no alarm budget
how_ours_differs: Our fleet-shared quantile model needs no own history; evaluated by false alarms per substation-year

paper: Using Weather and Schedule Based Pattern Matching and Feature Based Principal Component Analysis for Whole Building Fault Detection—Part II Field Evaluation
venue: ASME Journal of Engineering for Sustainable Buildings and Cities
problem: Whole-building HVAC fault detection field evaluation
method: Weather/schedule pattern matching + feature-based PCA
data: Campus building BAS with imposed and natural faults
evaluation_protocol: detection rate 85-100%, false alarm rate 0%
claimed_novelty: Field-evaluated whole-building FD
what_they_dont_do: Single building; not DH
how_ours_differs: Fleet-wide DH evaluation under continuous monitoring

paper: Evaluation of an Integrated Fault Detection and Compensation for Building-Level Radiator Systems in District Heating
problem: Detecting and compensating radiator valve/control faults in DH buildings
method: ML-informed proxy triggering fault-specific supervisory control
data: EnergyPlus simulation
evaluation_protocol: simulation ablation: discomfort degree-hours, energy
claimed_novelty: Integrated detection and compensation; stuck-open vs stuck-closed
what_they_dont_do: Simulation only; no field false-alarm evaluation
how_ours_differs: We use field data and comfort-loop setpoint shortfall as the monitored quantity

paper: A Multi-Turbine Approach for Improving Performance of Wind Turbine Power-Based Fault Detection Methods
problem: Power-curve dispersion degrades WT residual fault detection
method: Mono-multi-turbine residual generation (fleet reference)
data: Simulation framework (turbulent/laminar wind)
evaluation_protocol: simulated detection performance
claimed_novelty: Multi-turbine residuals make basic method as good as complex one
what_they_dont_do: Wind simulation; no alarm budget
how_ours_differs: Analogous finding that representation beats model complexity, here in DH field data

paper: Machine Learning and Cointegration for Wind Turbine Monitoring and Fault Detection: From a Comparative Study to a Combined Approach
problem: Reducing false alarms in WT ML fault detection
method: Cascade of ML long-term prediction with cointegration short-term verification
data: Five-year SCADA of one turbine with gearbox fault
evaluation_protocol: case study
claimed_novelty: Cascade lowers false-alarm risk
what_they_dont_do: Single turbine; no per-asset-year alarm metric
how_ours_differs: Fleet-wide continuous evaluation in DH
